text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Seiun Sky doesn't show up
for
morning training. It seems she hasn't
even come
to school...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been using my head to
win. Pretty
obvious, huh?
choice_data_list: （今、俺に出来ることは……）
（今、私に出来ることは……）
choice_data_list_en: (What can I do right now...?)
(What can I do right now...?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If that's what you call thinking up waaay too many scenarios and how you'd deal with them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm positive she's still trying to get
better, so I
have to figure out something
that can help her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night, it's peaceful and quiet...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're late. I thought you'd get here
sooner.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not a single one. All I've pulled up is
seaweed.
choice_data_list: 釣果は？
choice_data_list_en: How was the catch?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of gently breaking waves
interrupts the
silence. Without a word, I
cast my line beside
hers, and she begins
to open up little by little.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Obviously, I wasn't being serious back
there. I'm
not tired of racing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking... how am I supposed
to
overcome all these obstacles and
limitations I
have?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to beat other
Umamusume
who just keep getting
better and better, when I'm
already at
my peak?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I thought that if I went fishing... a
good
strategy might come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Back there... I wasn't for real, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hah. So you saw right through me.
choice_data_list: ああ、わかってる
うん、わかってる
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I know.
Yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I think King did too, at least a little.
She's just
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But... I really am stuck.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, fishing was pointless. I can't come
up with
anything. I'm just staring at the
water!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm through, I surrender, I'm waving the
white flag!
...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm just... so played out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's so played out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember when she said that before.
Those
words were directed at
herself—not at me or
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was high tide for me already.
My time's
over and done with, so I
should throw in the
towel!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's miraculous enough that someone as
weak as
me could get this far.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I even ran in the Classics like Gramps
always
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I should pat myself on the back and say,
"Nice
job, kiddo!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Right? I've already had a good
enough
career!
choice_data_list: ああ、頑張ったな
うん、頑張ったね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you worked hard.
Yeah, you worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: ああ、君は最高のウマ娘だ
うん、貴方は最高のウマ娘だよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're the best Umamusume there is.
Yeah, you're the greatest Umamusume there is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But... I can't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That moment when everyone's
perception of me
changed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The surprise, the commotion! The cheers
and
screams! That moment the world
turned upside
down!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wanna feel that excitement one more
time!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'll never snag another bite,
I can't
forget that moment. So I keep
casting my line.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She asked if I don't want to win
anymore...
choice_data_list: スカイ……
choice_data_list_en: Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I still wanna win, duh. That's
why I've
been running all this time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But, you know... I don't know anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's like there's a wall in front of me, with
a sign on
it saying, "This is as far as you
go."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I've been digging under or

clambering over the walls.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But it's clear there's no way for me to
get past this
one. I'm afraid to even run
toward it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm scared. I don't wanna know
that it's
over for me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns her head down, but I catch a
glimpse of
tears welling up in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she always acted carefree,
like
nothing ever affected her, she's
always been
battling this uncertainty...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah... There's nothing for you to
apologize for.
choice_data_list: ごめん、気づけなくて
choice_data_list_en: Sorry I didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one who can do anything
about this...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the only person you can rely
on... is
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's just what she said once before.
Sure, it's
true that her own strength is
what will carry her
forward, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Urgh! I can't even catch a damn fish...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Like, really! I'm such a loser right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup... And no matter how many times I
cast my
line, I don't get a thing.
choice_data_list: 君に出来ることは全部やったんだよな
貴方に出来ることは全部やったんだよね
choice_data_list_en: You did everything you possibly could, didn't you?
You did everything you could, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you—why are you walking
into the
water? W-wait a sec!
choice_data_list: なら次は俺の番だな！
なら次は私の番だね！
choice_data_list_en: Then it's my turn next!
Then it's my turn next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Trainer, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: H-huh, w-wait, wha? Uh... okay?
choice_data_list: 魚を追い込むぞ！タモ入れ頼んだ！
魚を追い込むよ！タモ入れ頼んだ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll corner the fish! Net it for me!
I'll corner the fish! Get the landing net ready!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase the fish toward where Sky is
waiting, and
then...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Got a small fry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean... does this really count as a
catch? I didn't
even use my rod.
choice_data_list: 小魚でも立派な釣果！
choice_data_list_en: Even small fish are a great catch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec... Sorry, my thoughts are
all over
the place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What... was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: 怖くても勇気を出せば、何か変わる！
choice_data_list_en: Even if you're scared, finding the courage will change things!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So you dove into the sea to show me
that?
Right... because...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Ahaha! I don't understand you at
all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so not like you! Oh boy, you
really
shocked me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like... you don't have to go to such
extremes if
you just want to give me
courage.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How is what you did going to make this
wall I'm
facing disappear?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: でも壊すことはまだ試してない
choice_data_list_en: Still, we haven't tried breaking it yet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But what if it doesn't work? What if this
just
becomes a painful memory?
choice_data_list: 勇気を出してぶつかってほしい
choice_data_list_en: I want you to be brave and face it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand her the materials I'd been
compiling since
this morning.
choice_data_list: 今の君なら絶対に壊せる
今の貴方なら絶対に壊せる
choice_data_list_en: With who you are now, you can definitely break through.
The way you are right now, you can definitely break through.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is... my training record up until now?
All the
races I ran up to the Takarazuka
Kinen are in
here...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hah. You even wrote down all the times
I
skipped? I definitely am a pain in your
neck, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: レースでもっと驚かせてくれるだろ？
レースでもっと驚かせてくれるでしょ？
choice_data_list_en: You're gonna surprise me even more in the race, right?
You'll surprise me even more in the race, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll start training again. But as for
racing... I can't
promise anything.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I might get scared and run away... You
okay with
that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Can you let me be alone for a while? I
promise
I'll be back before curfew.
choice_data_list: 信じてるよ
choice_data_list_en: I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that Sky will grasp something
from this.
Confident that she'll return to
racing, I leave her
to her thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Psh... You believe in me, huh?
